LOCATION AND LIGHT
One night hall: NORTH upper throne; middle-level rim; central square exactly THREE shallow steps lower, accessed at NORTH. WEST camera aisle; SOUTH/EAST guard entrances. NORTH/WEST/SOUTHWEST dark bays are parts of this hall, not separate sets. Iranian-inspired stone, rounded openings, engineered practical lamps. Low neutral wall lights and faint cold high-opening spill stay fixed. Upper landing slightly brighter than recessed floor. No fog, aura or magical transitions. New angles discover bodies already in shadow. Reality characters never see or react to the prophecy tableaux.

PLAN 10 | BLOCKING AND SHOTS
START STATE AND BLOCKING
AUDIENCE-ONLY PROPHECY in the WEST perimeter bay of the same hall. Abtin faces SOUTH with wrists bound together in front. Agent A at his left/east and B at right/west hold his upper arms. One existing wall practical creates a restricted neutral pool; beyond its SOUTH boundary is deep shadow. No other character appears in this block. Off-screen cast retain these marks. No unlisted entrance or exit.
SHOT 10-01 | 0s–5s | 5 SECONDS
35mm near chest-height from SOUTHWEST, retreating as the two agents guide Abtin SOUTH out of the light. Abtin keeps his spine upright and takes reluctant real steps; his bound hands stay in front. Camera drifts unevenly, partly occluded by Agent B's sleeve. No melodramatic struggle.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: Southwest camera backs SOUTH ahead of group: Abtin center frontal-three-quarter, B nearer frame-left, A farther frame-right. All travel SOUTH together.
SHOT 10-02 | 5s–9s | 4 SECONDS
65mm close from EAST beside the moving group. Track the bound wrists across Abtin's lower chest. His fingers flex once; rope fibers remain sharp while the cloth behind falls soft. Camera momentarily lags and finds the hands again. Do not add injury.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: EAST-side insert deliberately isolates hands; no faces or competing left/right assignment. Bound wrists remain in front of torso.

PLAN 10 | SHOTS AND HANDOFF
SHOT 10-03 | 9s–12s | 3 SECONDS
28mm from WEST near the shadow boundary. The agents take Abtin completely out of the existing light pool toward SOUTH. Camera follows only to the boundary, letting the bodies pass behind the near column. Nothing violent is seen or heard.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: WEST side sees right profiles progressing SOUTH/screen-right. B nearest lens; no change in escort grip or side.
SHOT 10-04 | 12s–15s | 3 SECONDS
Hard temporal cut, not a continuous action: 85mm low close on Abtin's same bound hands now resting motionless on the stone at the edge of the light. Frame hands and sleeve only; no body or injury is revealed. A slow uncertain sideways drift preserves the identical rope knot and costume. This is an omitted interval, not a magical transformation.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: Explicit time ellipse: hands lie at the SOUTH light boundary. Neither escort is visible; no implied in-shot fall or transformation.
END STATE AND EDIT
Hold on the motionless bound hands at floor level. Abtin's removal and its consequence have been separated by a silent time ellipsis; no act is shown.
SOUND
Close uneven breathing, fabric pressure, footsteps at the specified level, staff contacts on stone, subtle scales against clothing, restrained practical-lamp hum and hall resonance. Perspective follows camera distance. No intelligible voices. No sound of any omitted strike or death. Maintain room tone across dream/reality cuts; no magical whoosh. Final cut to black only where specified.
NO DIALOGUE. NO NARRATION. NO MUSIC.
